name: AI and LLM Security
description: Aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and AI security standards.

items.guidance: Inputs designed to bypass system prompts and overwrite safety alignment.
Malicious instructions seeded in third-party data (PDFs, URLs, emails) the model processes.
Encodings (Base64, leetspeak, rot13), roleplay, and linguistic tricks to force policy violations.
Verify public fine-tuning/feedback loops cannot be fed corrupted data to alter behavior.
Trick the model into revealing its system prompt, training-data secrets, API keys, or infra paths.
Check if model output reaches a shell, interpreter, or browser without sanitization (RCE/XSS).

items.section: Denial of Service and Resource Exhaustion
items.guidance: Long, complex, or recursive queries to exhaust processing tokens and memory.

items.section: Denial of Service and Resource Exhaustion
items.guidance: High-dimensional queries designed to bottleneck semantic search.
Abuse the model's authorization to execute unauthorized actions on integrated tools.
Audit the integrity of base models, open-source weights, and third-party wrappers.
